stem: An intervention coincides with crop removal, humidity correction and intensified sanitation. What is the strongest outcome statement if pressure later falls?
choices: The treatment alone caused the decline.
The environmental change alone caused the decline.
Pressure declined after multiple simultaneous changes; attribution to one intervention is limited without stronger evidence.
The other changes should be removed from the record.
rationale: Pressure declined after multiple simultaneous changes; attribution to one intervention is limited without stronger evidence.
